source: TrustLensAI_TimeSeries_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Time-Series RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Time-Series pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: fit parameters, hyperparameters, retraining cadence, DP ε/δ
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: walk-forward folds, embargo/gap, leakage checks, OOS vs IS
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: point forecasts, realized actuals, errors, horizon
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: forecasts/alerts served, latency, throughput, cost, alert dispatch
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance
